messages:
maria: quick q — where do I pull p50/p95/p99 TTFT for the hosted -> model=v2-small traffic? need to validate a perf claim for a customer. :eyes:
aj: grafana -> Observability / Inference / Latency Overview. there are panels for p50/p95/p99 and a TTFT heatmap. quick promql for p95 TTFT (5m):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route))
```
filter by `model="v2-small"`. the dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/latency/inference-latency-overview
aj: if you want raw timeseries per route use the `inference_ttft_seconds` summary metric and `quantile_over_time(0.95, inference_ttft_seconds[5m])` for a quick check
maria: ah thanks. where do I grab traces for a slow request? I want full span/tokens timeline to see if KV cache is missing
corey: Jaeger is the place — https://jaeger.internal/redwood. in logs we surface `trace_id` and `request_id` (see `inference_request_total{request_id!=""}`). if a Grafana panel shows a spike, click the point -> link to trace (we add a `Open trace` action).
dave: if you plan to change alerts, FYI current prod rule `TTFT_P95_HIGH` fires when p95 > 800ms for 5m (rulepath: monitoring/alerts/inference.rules.yml). consider model-specific thresholds for large models, e.g. 1.5s for >4k context. runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/ttft_high
corey: also correlate tokens/sec — high tokens/sec + low batch size often increases median but can also push p99. panel name: `Tokens per second (by model+route)` on the same dashboard. promql example: 
```
sum(rate(inference_tokens_total[1m])) by (model, route)
```
devex: small tip — use the `request.load` variable on the dashboard to toggle short vs long sequences, it will update queries and show per-route token rates. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: alert TTFT_P95_HIGH fired for model=v2-small in eu-west-1 at 1809123200 (p95=0.93s). linked incident: https://incidents.internal/INC-2028
maria: perfect. last q — can we get a quick query I can paste into a PR comment that shows p50/p95/p99 for v2-small across last 30m?
aj: paste this: 
```
eval_p50=histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[30m])) by (le, model));
eval_p95=histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[30m])) by (le, model));
eval_p99=histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[30m])) by (le, model));
# then filter where model="v2-small"
```
maria: thanks — i'll add that to the perf PR and link the trace if I see anything weird. appreciate the pointers. :raised_hands:
